caption.en: Two developers use a diagram to explain how an API handles a request and returns a response.
caption.zh: 两名开发者借助示意图，解释接口接收请求并返回响应的数据流。

description.en: Two developers use a diagram to explain how an API handles a request and returns a response.
description.zh: 两名开发者借助示意图，解释接口接收请求并返回响应的数据流。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Could you explain the data flow for this API?
dialogue.zh: 你能解释一下这个接口的数据流吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: A request comes in, and the service reads the data from storage.
dialogue.zh: 请求进入后，服务会从存储中读取数据。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Then it sends a response back to the client, right?
dialogue.zh: 然后它会向客户端返回响应，对吗？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Exactly. The diagram shows the path.
dialogue.zh: 没错。示意图展示了这条路径。

image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure developers stand beside a wide whiteboard. Inside the whiteboard is ONE simple left-to-right connected flow diagram: a small blank laptop-shaped client icon at left, one rectangular service block in the center, one cylinder-shaped storage icon at right, and clear directional arrows linking them, including a return arrow. No letters, text, or numbers. One developer points at a connector while the other listens. Keep all nodes and arrows inside the board clear and unobstructed.
